stats-correlation-three.alt: Three scatterplots of ten invented points each. Left: points rise from lower left to upper right, r = +0.97, a strong positive correlation, with a rising line of best fit. Middle: points scattered with no pattern, r = +0.02, little or no correlation. Right: points fall from upper left to lower right, r = -0.89, a strong negative correlation, with a falling line of best fit. The sign of r gives the direction and its size the strength.
